title: Revenue Accounting Annexe for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Agency Service Fee Recovery on a Travel Credit Carry Forward
content:
Where a booking under Air Ticket Fare Brands has borne the agency's service fee, a recovery is taken off in dollars, last of all, on a travel credit carry forward. Two things determine it: how many agency service fee lines stand on the booking, and whether the agency service fee of the fare brand held reaches the service-fee band of 25.00 US dollars.

- Where two or more agency service fee lines stand on the booking and the agency service fee of the fare brand held is at or above 25.00 US dollars, the party service recovery of 30.00 US dollars is taken off in dollars, last of all.
- Where exactly one agency service fee line stands on the booking and the agency service fee of the fare brand held is at or above 25.00 US dollars, the single service recovery of 15.00 US dollars is taken off in dollars, last of all.
- Otherwise nothing is taken off in dollars for the agency service fee.

**Both sides of the band.** A fare brand whose agency service fee is exactly 25.00 US dollars is at the band, and the recovery is taken off in dollars, last of all: 30.00 US dollars where two or more agency service fee lines stand on the booking, and 15.00 US dollars where exactly one does. A fare brand whose agency service fee is 24.99 US dollars is below the band, and nothing is taken off in dollars for the agency service fee however many agency service fee lines stand on the booking. Where no agency service fee line stands on the booking, nothing is taken off in dollars for the agency service fee either.

**A worked determination on hypothetical figures.** A booking carrying three agency service fee lines, held on a fare brand whose agency service fee is 40.00 US dollars, is at the band and stands on two or more lines, so 30.00 US dollars is taken off in dollars, last of all.
